fusions.name: Clipped Primaries
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 7 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows it by 25% for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Portcullis
fusions.desc: Drops on every enemy within 3 tiles for 26 damage plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves them [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Shut the Door Behind
fusions.desc: Drives a line of bars 5 tiles long into the ground for 6 seconds, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Nowhere to Fly
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage, and your dodge chance rises by 5%.
